name: Ground (comp background)
description: Sets the composition ground: a flat colour (the references' default: light grey #e4e6e3 or near-black), or a soft radial / linear falloff from colour to colour2. Apply first. Not a layer, so it never clips and never moves with a camera.
source: r06 black ground with a radial dome

style.description: solid = one flat colour (most references); radial = colour in the middle falling off to colour2 at the edges; linear = top colour to bottom colour2.

color.description: Main ground colour (#e4e6e3 light grey, #0b0b0d near-black, #ffffff white).

color2.description: Edge / bottom colour for radial and linear. Default: colour darkened 30 %.

angle.description: Linear only: gradient angle in degrees (180 = top to bottom).
